answer: Proof-of-Stake mechanisms provide robust Sybil resistance by requiring agents to lock capital as a crystal clear signal of commitment. By linking identity to resource scarcity, the network forces an attacker to purchase vast assets, effectively isolating their influence to a lonely island of inefficiency. The cost to the adversary scales linearly with the network value, rendering large-scale identity forgery prohibitively expensive compared to the potential gains from controlling the consensus flow.
